sources.note: First-hand tone-split datum from the author's Lao fieldwork. The paper gives 'a catalogue of Central and SWT tone systems' (p. 49); entry 32 'Tai Meuai, Tai Kuan' (p. 56) stands in the P group under the heading 'P - *ABCD 123-4' (p. 55). Its Gedney box (columns A B C DL DS, rows 1-4) shows a single register split between rows 1-2-3 and row 4 drawn under A, B, C and DL, arcs joining B and DL above and below (B=DL coalescence), and no other mergers boxed; as drawn in the scan the split line stops at the DL/DS divider (contrast entries 31 and 33 on the same page, where it runs under DS), so the…
